import scipy.optimize as so
o=np.ones(len(t))
base=[o,x,v,x*x,x*v,v*v,x**3,x*x*v,x*v*v,v**3]
def model(p,kind):
    if kind==0:  # exp-decayed drive
        w,b=p[0],p[1]; g=np.exp(-b*t)
        T=[g*np.cos(w*t),g*np.sin(w*t)]
    elif kind==1: # chirp
        w,b=p[0],p[1]
        T=[np.cos(w*t+b*t*t),np.sin(w*t+b*t*t)]
    elif kind==2: # two freq
        w,b=p[0],p[1]
        T=[np.cos(w*t),np.sin(w*t),np.cos(b*t),np.sin(b*t)]
    A=np.column_stack(base+T)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((dv_dt-A@c)**2)/np.var(dv_dt)
for kind in [0,1,2]:

        for b0 in [-0.2,0.0,0.05,0.3]:
            try:
                r=so.minimize(lambda p: model(p,kind),[w0,b0],method='Nelder-Mead',options={'maxiter':300})
                if r.fun<bestn[0]: bestn=(r.fun,r.x)
            except Exception as e: pass

def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[1] + params[2]*x + params[3]*v + params[4]*x*x + params[5]*x*v + params[6]*v*v
